content:
We're excited to announce the release of Veil, a framework for verifying distributed & concurrent systems both automatically and interactively, embedded in Lean.

Veil gives you the best of both worlds when verifying transition systems:
– Push-button verification via SMT solvers
– Interactive proofs when automation falls short

It comes with a Ivy-style imperative DSL shallowly embedded in Lean to specify transitions, and lightweight syntax for specifying invariants. Verification conditions are native Lean goals, which you can discharge with SMT or interactively. If your candidate invariant is not inductive, you get to see a concrete counter-example to induction. Moreover, you can do symbolic bounded model checking, and more features are coming soon!

With Veil, complex protocols that were previously checked using a combination of Ivy and Coq can now be verified using a single framework.

:working_on_it: Code: https://github.com/verse-lab/veil
:document: Paper: https://pirlea.net/papers/veil-cav25.pdf
